headline: Anthropic releases Haiku 5.5 with reported computer-use gains and lower per-token prices
summary: Anthropic announced Claude Haiku 5.5 on 7 October 2026 (model ID claude-haiku-5-5) and says it is available on its platform and major cloud providers. The release reports 72.4% on the OSWorld 2.1 offline subset and publishes API prices by prompt length. Its system-card executive summary additionally reports no new Responsible Scaling Policy thresholds, low assessed misalignment risk under its evaluations, tested prompt-injection robustness, and an over-refusal caveat. These are provider-reported findings; the card summary was inspected, but detailed protocols and independent matched results remain unavailable.
